answer.rationale: Rollback is barred by the non-revertible security patch, so b1 is inapplicable. The degradation is confined to the primary region with settlement writes at peak, which most closely matches the regional-isolation pattern in b2 (clean shift, minutes-level recovery) rather than a capacity (b3), partner-dependency (b4), or read-contention (b5) signature. I want b2 verified for clean traffic shift/write safety and b5 verified to rule out the lower-risk read-replica alternative before shifting a write-heavy peak. Failover is the intended single intervention, but in-flight settlement writes and the undiagnosed root cause keep risk flagged and confidence moderate.
